arguments.summary: Proactive hardening exercise initiated based on new threat intelligence regarding a recurring threat actor. This incident involved the replay of containment actions from four previous incidents (INC-2026-0555, INC-2026-0587, INC-2026-0601, INC-2026-0598), including host quarantine, user account disable, external IP block, and critical patching. While the actions were successfully re-executed in the Admin phase for host scanning, firewall and IAM actions were denied due to lack of explicit approval in this context. Post-action monitoring showed no signs of active compromise, and a suspicious file analyzed was deemed benign.
